node.label: Akira Iriye
node.date_label: After Imperialism (1965) · Cultural Internationalism and World Order (1997) · Global Community (2002)
node.description: Historian of international relations who brought cultural exchange and non-state organizations into accounts of world order. In his interview with Peter Frost,Iriye distinguishes state power from cultural initiatives while recognizing their interaction and the wartime subordination of culture to power. His internationalization of history argues for cross-national inquiry rather than a history bounded by one country’s perspective.
